summary.title: Startup CTO Resources
summary.one_liner: A curated index of blog posts on the startup CTO role, covering hiring, equity and salary, technical advisors, and the difference between CTOs and VP Engineering.
keywords: what does a startup cto do
finding a cto for my startup
takeaways: The page is a link index to posts on the startup CTO role rather than a single article.
Topics include CTO equity and salary trends for 2009-2011 and visualizations of that data.
Posts cover hiring a CTO, finding a technical cofounder, part-time or consulting CTOs, and technical advisors.
It also explains how a CTO differs from a VP Engineering and what a startup CTO actually does.
summary.summary: This page is a curated list of blog posts by a Southern California CTO on the startup CTO role, with a link to free CTO consulting sessions and a speaking-topics page. The entries are article titles only, with no body text on the page, so the summaries are drawn from titles. Topics include equity and salary data for 2009-2011, hiring a CTO, technical cofounders, part-time and equity-only CTOs, technical advisors, and the CTO versus VP Engineering distinction. It is a reading index rather than a tutorial.
